name: ielts-sprint-firefox
description: A free, private, keyboard-first IELTS practice companion for Firefox.

scripts.build: tsc && cp manifest.json popup.html popup.css dist/ && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp icons/icon.svg dist/icons/
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../ielts-sprint-firefox.zip .
